hypothesis: A pairwise value head over the four-member frozen temporal consequence ensemble ranks successful candidate first actions above failed alternatives on the untouched C33 source episodes and outperforms an action-only shortcut.
single_variable: The primary value representation adds only the frozen C38 ensemble's predicted future-minus-current H3 consequence to a matched action-only design; train-only CV, pairwise loss, source split, projection width and fresh ranking evaluation are otherwise identical.
parent_baseline: C38 corrected audit SHA256 c5709b8d2009deebff42a801592618305d30887ae17ed6fccf2d8a7d862818f5 passed four new seeds with minimum paired-null gain12.63%, shuffle degradation1.76%, shuffled-train gain7.48% and exact eval-mode restore. C33 has never trained or selected a consequence model.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models

architecture.paper: Action-conditioned future tokens support a value head used for best-of-N.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT Stage2 consumes clean action, predicts future/value, then scores sampled plans.
architecture.local: Four frozen C38 temporal experts predict future H3; only a 64D pairwise linear value head trains.
architecture.rationale: The isolated head preserves the proven frozen-H3 path and is appropriate for 83 train pairs.

data.paper: Failure-aware value training retains mixed outcomes and evaluates unseen episodes.
data.upstream_code: FACT trains value on success/failure trajectories.
data.local: Only 25 mixed consequence-train groups/83 pairs fit or select the ranker; 24 C33 mixed groups/81 pairs from 52 untouched sources are evaluated once.
data.rationale: The eight consumed consequence-validation sources are excluded from both ranker fitting and final C33 metrics.

action.paper: Each sampled action is scored through its predicted consequence.
action.upstream_code: FACT evaluates multiple sampled plans under a shared state.
action.local: Four exact executed 32x7 prefixes per bit-exact state generate consequence features and within-state success/failure pairs.
action.rationale: No observed future is available to the ranker at candidate selection time.

objective.paper: Lower predicted cost selects better plans.
objective.local: Balanced logistic differences fit success>failure; label-shuffled controls and action-only baseline test shortcuts.
objective.rationale: Pairwise supervision matches the four-candidate causal dataset.

optimization.paper: Value hyperparameters are selected without final test labels.
optimization.local: Five deterministic source folds select steps in10/30/100 and weight decay0.3/3/10 separately per arm; LR0.03, projection32 and seed20260815 are fixed.
optimization.rationale: Small-data regularization is chosen exclusively inside the 25 train groups.

evaluation.paper: Offline value must improve held-out ranking before closed loop.
evaluation.upstream_code: Best-of-N is evaluated after value learning.
evaluation.local: PASS requires pairwise>=0.60, top1>=0.60, >=0.05 over action-only and shuffled controls, Monte Carlo permutation p<=0.05, train accuracy>=0.75 and score variation in every group.
evaluation.rationale: Passing permits only a bounded N=1 versus N=4 closed-loop canary.

evidence: Four exact-restored temporal conditioned checkpoints form a frozen arithmetic ensemble; only linear ranker trains.
25 train mixed groups; 24 untouched C33 mixed groups; source folds lock d3/d5 states together.
Exact actions, zero tails and predicted-not-observed consequence inputs are enforced.
All seven promotion thresholds and 10 shuffled-label seeds fixed before C33 labels are evaluated.
Finite nine-point train-only CV grid; fixed LR/projections; no C33 selection.
C33 is consumed once by this preregistered primary ensemble; action-only is the fixed baseline.
All H3/consequence models frozen; only pairwise weights receive gradients.
No best-of-N rollout before fresh offline PASS.

decision.rationale: C38 has a repeated action-to-future mechanism and C33 supplies the untouched mixed outcomes needed for the first valid value-ranking test.
decision.launch_command: Run train_c40_fresh_consequence_value_ranker.py once with the frozen C34 data/features and all four C38 step10000 checkpoints; do not rerun C33 with alternate configurations.
